title: Use Seedance 2.0 in ComfyUI with reference images to test different visual…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 in ComfyUI with reference images to test different visual styles while keeping the same motion and camera movement  
Start from a simple Blender scene animation so you can easily compare different creative directions across styles
